tier_should.rationale: Novel synthesis of epidemiological dynamics with reduced-form economics; credible measles modeling; policy-relevant finding that severity, not infections, drives human capital impacts. Empirical leverage and writing clarity limit general-interest appeal, but strong fit for health economics/demography field journals.

tier_will.rationale: Solid, policy-relevant and methodologically credible, but identification is modest and exposition uneven; likely to place in reputable health economics or demography journals rather than top general-interest outlets.
